title: BLACKWATER TIMBER
heading: BLACKWATER
TIMBER
intro: ISOLATE THE WEST FEED AND TRIP THE DRY-KILN BELT.

stations.label: ISOLATE WEST FEED
stations.message: WEST FEED ISOLATED. SERVICE GATE OPEN.

stations.label: STRIKE THE KILN BELT RELEASE
stations.message: KILN STOPPED. THE RETURN SHUTTER IS OPEN.

stations.label: SHUT DOWN THE MILL RELAY
stations.message: SPLINTER FOREMAN! WATCH THE CUT MARKS.

stations.label: RELEASE THE LOG CARRIAGE BRAKE
stations.message: CARRIAGE STOPPED. PUMP HOUSE ACCESS OPEN.

notes: BLUE TRUNK / WENT TO STILLWATER. TAG TOO TOUGH FOR THE SAW.

mill-leaky-standpipe: STANDPIPE SHUDDERS. STEP OFF THE GRATE.
quarry-cut-leak: COPPER JOINT WHISTLES. GIVE IT ROOM.
